calendarSettings.title: Calendar
calendarSettings.intro: Deadlines go into a separate calendar, “Sottomano”. You can hide it in the Calendar app; turning it off here deletes it.
calendarSettings.details: Each deadline is an all-day event “Expires: title”, with no other details from the document. If Sottomano’s reminders are off, the event alerts you at 9:00 on the reminder day; if they’re on, only the app alerts you, so you don’t get two alerts.
